summary: This is a Phase 0 investigation/documentation deliverable for the VERIDIAN 20-engine/10-gateway architecture: two generator scripts (ai-os-scripts/generate_engines_gateways_inventory.py, ai-os-scripts/generate_capability_registry_candidates.py) that live-verify os.path.exists() for every cited file before writing YAML output, plus the resulting phase-plan and capability-registry-schema YAML files and a MASTER_INDEX.yaml registry entry. I independently re-ran both generator scripts on the live server and confirmed their self-checks pass (20/20 engine rows verified, 17/17 capability paths verified, zero drift), spot-checked a further 10 exists_as paths by hand (all real), and confirmed all three new/modified YAML files parse cleanly. The work is honest about its limits rather than fabricating: it explicitly declines to invent a 10-gateway name list when no canonical source exists on the server, flags that as a real gap, and marks dependency-table edges as 'planned' vs 'live' rather than overclaiming. The diff is purely additive (new scripts, new YAML docs, a MASTER_INDEX.yaml registry entry, a PROGRESS.md update) with no touches to migrations, schema.sql, auth/, payment/billing/rls paths, or .github/workflows/**, consistent with the pre-classified tier1 risk tier. No security, correctness, or architecture-soundness issues found.
